notes: Partition verified: 18 source and 27 target IDs each used once, heads all in-array.

ἑορτάζωμεν heads on *feast* as a denominal verb with an empty support verb (rules 66, 91), corroborated by the ASV's own gloss note *Greek keep festival*; a head on *keep* is the competing reading and is refused by rule 17.
The supplied determiners at *the leaven* and *the unleavened bread* are helpers on anarthrous Greek under rule 51, no article standing in either phrase.

ἀζύμοις is substantival, so it takes the supplied determiner and the supplied generic *bread* itself under rule 58's substantival arm, headed on *unleavened*; rule 102 is not in question because no Greek article governs the phrase.
